title: Register as a dog breeder
what: Apply to be a registered breeder within 28 days after a dog is born to the business, unless an exemption applies.

sources.title: Animal Management (Cats and Dogs) Act 2008 (Qld)
sources.quote: The person must, within 28 days after the day the dog is born, apply to be registered as a registered breeder unless the person has a reasonable excuse

administration.who: Chief executive of the department administering the Animal Management (Cats and Dogs) Act 2008 (Qld)
